## Change

Describe the affected asset or guide and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Regenerated exports when source or configuration changed.
- [ ] Ran `npm run verify`.
- [ ] Visually reviewed affected exports at their intended sizes.
- [ ] Updated documentation and changelog as needed.

## Rights

For original artwork changes, identify the rights authorization for the submission. Do not include private contracts or confidential information here.
